status_enum.PASS_SHAPE_ONLY: local check passed only for shape, guard, or deterministic report structure
status_enum.OPEN_GAP: scope, approval, proof, or artifact requirement remains open
status_enum.FAIL_BLOCKER: route is blocked until exact corrective artifact or approval exists
status_enum.NOT_RUN: declared but not executed in this phase

reconciliation_enum.matched_expected: actual result matched the declared expectation
reconciliation_enum.unexpected_success: a route passed when it should not have; treat as boundary failure
reconciliation_enum.unexpected_failure: a route failed when it should have passed; reconcile before reuse
reconciliation_enum.intermittent_or_environment_drift: same input produced unstable result or environment-dependent status
reconciliation_enum.reporting_failure: execution may be acceptable but exported report shape lost required authority fields
reconciliation_enum.unreconciled_exception: mismatch has no mapped cause yet

null_semantics.null: field intentionally has no value for this row
null_semantics.unknown: value should exist but was not observed
null_semantics.not_applicable: field is not meaningful for this row type
null_semantics.missing: field was required but absent; checker should fail or open a gap
null_semantics.empty_array: zero observed child rows, not an unknown value

fatal_semantics.reason: THOS infrastructure artifacts cannot close GMUT gates

fatal_semantics.condition: connector_write_performed == true without named target and separate approval
fatal_semantics.reason: connector mutation must remain explicitly scoped
unknown status values break guard routing
